notes: Qualification evidence from the pinned source build (0.4.0-dev, build 1, commit 465e49b9c; server build_info b1-465e49b9c) on Apple silicon (Metal). The determinism audit now runs as an enforced pre-gate inside the canary runner and is embedded in its output. Earlier stock-distribution numbers (0.3.0, c1d0e7a00) reproduced identically on the pinned build, including the 553-token reuse truncation.

facts.hybrid_ssm_reuse_boundary: On divergence after a 1065-token reused prefix, the slot reused 553 tokens where the true common prefix was 1059; llama.cpp truncates reuse at the last recurrent-state snapshot instead of the true token LCP. Reproduced bit-for-bit across both builds tested (stock 0.3.0 c1d0e7a00 and pinned source 465e49b9c) and both devices tested (Metal and CPU): upstream, device-independent behavior. Conservative and mechanically safe, but LCP-based accounting must not assume token-prefix reuse on hybrid backends.
